subject: Headroom safety net — bundled standby credits and rate staircase
messages:
From: Maya Shah <maya@brightcart.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: BrightCart Billing <billing@brightcart.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term headroom + bundled standby credit for upcoming promo

Hi Karthik,

We're running a one-week promotional campaign for our mobile checkout (May 12–18) and expect a 4–6x spike in per-second QPS for the first 48 hours. Our engineers estimate peak token spend will exceed our committed tier by ~2.7x for two days.

We like Redwood's billing predictability, but this is a short, high-impact burst tied to revenue. Can you share options for: 1) short-term quota uplift (temporary QPS headroom), 2) a bundled standby-credit arrangement (prepaid credit applied only to overrun during the event), and 3) a staged rate for any sustained overrun beyond 72 hours?

If it helps, we can provide projected traffic curves and a PO. We need pricing and a simple amendment by EOD May 7 to finalize procurement.

Thanks — Maya
Maya Shah
Head of Platform Engineering, BrightCart

Attachments: traffic_estimate_preview.csv (referenced)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Maya Shah <maya@brightcart.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term headroom + bundled standby credit for upcoming promo

Maya — thanks for the heads up. This is a tight window but doable.

Ben / Lauren — looped in to propose a pragmatic path: we can offer a temporary QPS headroom for the 72-hour launch window with a standby-credit bundle (prepaid tokens that apply only to overrun). After 72 hours, we move to a stepped overrun rate (tiered surcharge).

Key asks for pricing:
- Confirm projected peak start/end (you mentioned 48 hours of heavy load).
- Confirm whether BrightCart wants the standby credit refundable if unused (we typically structure as non-refundable but transferable to future invoices within 90 days).
- PO or billing contact for quick procurement (you cc'd billing which helps).

I tagged Lauren to draft the pricing matrix and Ben to approve the commercial concession. I can shepherd the amendment and DocuSign flow.

Karthik
Sr. Strategic Account Manager
Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Maya Shah <maya@brightcart.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term headroom + bundled standby credit for upcoming promo

Hi Maya — proposed options below. Attached is a compact pricing matrix so you can plug in your numbers (headroom-pricing-matrix.xlsx).

Option A — Standby bundle (recommended for predictable cost):
- One-time prepaid standby credit covering up to 3x committed monthly tokens applied only to overrun during the May 12–18 window.
- Credit size suggestion: 350% of monthly baseline (you can adjust in the sheet).
- Unused credit: transferable to invoices within 90 days; non-refundable.
- Effective rate for overrun against credit: standard payg rate (no surcharge).

Option B — Temporary QPS headroom + stepped overrun:
- 72-hour temporary headroom (reserved QPS) at a blended uplift of 25% to the committed rate (covers bursting without touching credit).
- If overrun persists beyond 72 hours, surcharge tiers: 1.1x for the first 24h past window, 1.35x for 24–72h, 1.6x beyond that.

Option C — Hybrid: small standby credit + 48–72h headroom with a softened surcharge curve.

Legal / procurement notes:
- We can do a one-click amendment (DocuSign) for the standby bundle + PO.
- For discounts or waived surcharge, Ben will need to approve.

If you confirm which option and whether you want unused credit transferable or refundable, I'll prepare an amendment and include a simple SLA credit clause (minor, tied to latency SLO misses during the event).

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Principal Pricing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: headroom-pricing-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Maya Shah <maya@brightcart.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: BrightCart Billing <billing@brightcart.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term headroom + bundled standby credit for upcoming promo

Lauren — thanks, that matrix is helpful. BrightCart prefers Option C (hybrid): a modest prepaid standby credit (200% monthly baseline, transferable within 60 days) plus a 48-hour reserved headroom window. If we exceed the 48 hours, the softened surcharge curve you suggested works, but can you cap the top-tier surcharge at 1.45x instead of 1.6x? Our CFO will push back otherwise.

Procurement attached a PO (BrightCart_PO_0452.pdf) for the standby credit amount. Legal will want a brief amendment and to confirm the transferability window is 60 days (not 90).

We'd like to execute by EOD May 7 to keep procurement timelines.

— Maya

Attachments: BrightCart_PO_0452.pdf (PO stub)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Maya Shah <maya@brightcart.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Final terms: BrightCart hybrid headroom + capped surcharge approval

Maya — apologies for the slight delay; wanted to confirm approvals internally before committing.

We can proceed with Option C (hybrid) under these final terms:
- Standby credit: prepaid equal to 200% of your monthly baseline, transferable to invoices within 60 days, non-refundable.
- Reserved headroom: 48-hour reserved QPS window starting at the first surge hour during May 12–18 event.
- Surcharge tiers after headroom window: 1.15x for 0–24h, 1.35x for 24–48h, capped at 1.45x beyond that.
- SLA credit: up to 5% service-credit tied to latency SLO misses during the 48-hour headroom window (standard carveouts apply).
- Amendment: I'll send a DocuSign amendment (same-day) referencing PO BC-0452 and HubSpot deal BC-2027-0419.

Lauren — please attach the amendment PDF and route the DocuSign to Maya and BrightCart Billing. Karhtik, please track execution and provisioning so infra can add the reserved headroom before May 12.

Maya — once DocuSign is complete, we'll provision reserved QPS and apply the standby credit invoice-side.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Commercial Pricing
Redwood Inference
